native_computation: Retain the adapter frame unchanged. Canonicalization operates on an export copy after decisions and validation.
input: Already published return_net decimal lattice, 12 fractional places; non-finite missing values become zero as in the active transform; infinity and values outside that lattice fail closed.
ordering: Unique increasing ISO date rows; never silently reorder or deduplicate.
precision_basis: Preserve the existing active adapter public precision of 12 decimal places for returns and these diagnostics. No precision reduction is based on observed ARM/x86 differences. Volatility is an annualized return fraction (one unit is 100 percentage points); Sharpe is dimensionless.
variance: Population ddof=0. For integer returns x, n*sum(x*x)-sum(x)**2 is computed exactly with unbounded integers; no cancellation or negative-variance clamp.
representation: Decimal numbers with 12 fractional places, ROUND_HALF_EVEN; zero is positive zero. CSV uses fixed decimal text. JSON remains numeric. Exact scaled integer values accompany audit evidence.
rounding: Round the rational square root using integer isqrt and exact comparison against the squared half-integer midpoint, including ties to even.
zero_variance: volatility=0; Sharpe=null, including nonzero constant returns
oracle: Test/audit only: independent centered two-pass Decimal mean/variance and sqrt at 80 decimal digits, checked again at 120 digits; never imported by production signal code.
error_bound: Canonical decimal rounding at most 0.5e-12 per finite metric relative to its exact decimal-return definition. No acceptance tolerance: compare canonical outputs and all decisions exactly.
threshold_influence: Exactly zero: neither diagnostic is an input to selected asset, exposure, permission, risk scaling or planner. No margin requirement or approximation is applied to decision thresholds.
forbidden: using diagnostic metrics as execution inputs
